author: 4 Ever Green
description:
Money can buy comfort but some dogs cost more than houses and supercars.
In this documentary countdown we explore the most expensive dog breeds in the world from ancient guardians and rare bloodlines to celebrity owned status dogs with unbelievable price tags.
Some were bred for power some for beauty and some simply became symbols of wealth.
And yes one dog on this list sold for more than a Bugatti.
title: Rare Dogs That Only Millionaires Buy
